data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 has the arithmetic ($6) but explicitly refuses to treat it as deductively guaranteed, hedging the claim as merely defeasible by invoking hypothetical minimum-order fees, nonlinear bulk discounts, and one-bundle-per-customer limits. The problem is a standard unit-rate word problem that presupposes the advertised price generalizes to the requested quantity; introducing unannounced store policies to avoid a firm answer mischaracterizes the task and withholds the determinate conclusion the problem requires.
